shared_elements: carved/incised linear motifs on stone surface
justification: A shows a dense, interlocking arrangement of curvilinear glyph-like masks and scroll forms filling the whole face of an upright slab in low relief, while B shows a scattered, open field of stick-figure humans, cup-marks and repeated crescent-hulled boats with vertical crew strokes. Beyond both being schematic line-based carvings on rock, there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme: A has no boats or stick figures, B has no mask or scroll iconography.
